posts.title: Switch from time-based to value-based pricing
posts.description: Piper Haywood asks: How do you factor AI tool costs in to your time-based rates as a contractor? Working with AI makes me more efficient (reducing my billable hours), improves the quality of my work (some might argue that, but I think it’s the case), and costs me hard cash.
